turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, doctor. A bit sleepy, but not in too much pain.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Can you tell me your pain level on a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'd say about a 3. The nerve block seems to be helping a lot.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Are you feeling nauseous or have been sick at all since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, no nausea. I feel fine in that way.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. How about your breathing? Any discomfort or difficulty breathing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I'm breathing fine. Chest feels okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Do you remember anything about the surgery itself? Any awareness during the procedure?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't remember anything. I was out the whole time.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected with general anesthesia. Given your diabetes and kidney condition, we'll keep a close eye on your fluids and blood sugar levels. Any other concerns from your side?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all. Thank you for checking on me.
